from pathlib import Path
import shutil, json
src=Path('target/packages/contracts')
dst=Path('work/proof-work/contracts')
symlinks=[str(p) for p in src.rglob('*') if p.is_symlink()]
if symlinks: raise RuntimeError('Source symlinks require explicit confinement review: '+repr(symlinks))
if dst.exists(): raise RuntimeError('Refusing to overwrite existing isolated copy')
shutil.copytree(src,dst)
for n in ['svm','foundry','xdg-cache','xdg-config','tmp']:
 (dst.parent/n).mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
print(json.dumps({'isolated_copy':str(dst.resolve()),'file_count':sum(1 for p in dst.rglob('*') if p.is_file()),'source_unchanged':True}))
